feed.title: Single-Cell Foundation Model Tracker — weekly changes
feed.subtitle: What moved in the single-cell foundation model field this week: new models, rank changes, repositories going quiet, and new benchmarking papers.

entry.title: Week of 2026-09-28: 2 changes
entry.content:
• New evaluation — “Evaluating Large‐Language Models in Bioinformatics Applications” (Advanced Computing) — covers scGPT. DOI
  • Citations — 17 other citing papers newly indexed, none of them evaluations.

entry.title: Week of 2026-09-21: 3 changes
entry.content:
• New evaluation — “Benchmarking methods for inferring single-cell transcription factor activity using large-scale perturbation sequencing data” (Briefings in Bioinformatics) — covers scGPT, scFoundation. DOI
  • New evaluation — “An open benchmark and language models for AI in aging biology” (Cell) — covers scGPT. DOI
  • Citations — 23 other citing papers newly indexed, none of them evaluations.

entry.title: Week of 2026-09-14: 5 changes
entry.content:
• Upkeep — Geneformer's repository is being actively developed again.
  • New evaluation — “A systematic comparison of single-cell perturbation response prediction models” (Science Advances) — covers scGPT, Geneformer, scFoundation, STATE. DOI
  • New evaluation — “Cell-type separability predicts annotation accuracy and outweighs algorithm choice: a factorial benchmark across seven scRNA paradigms” (bioRxiv (Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory)) — covers scGPT, Geneformer, scBERT, scFoundation. DOI
  • New evaluation — “scDiagnostics: systematic assessment of cell type annotation in single-cell transcriptomics data” (Briefings in Bioinformatics) — covers scGPT. DOI
  • Citations — 26 other citing papers newly indexed, none of them evaluations.

entry.title: Week of 2026-09-07: 4 changes
entry.content:
• Upkeep — GeneCompass's repository is being actively developed again.
  • New evaluation — “Benchmarking biomedical foundation models” (Nature Methods) — covers Nicheformer. DOI
  • New evaluation — “Basal expression predicts context-specific drug responses only where they are reproducible: a leakage-safe 47-line LOCO benchmark on Tahoe-100M” (Research Square) — covers STATE. DOI
  • Citations — 20 other citing papers newly indexed, none of them evaluations.

entry.title: Change tracking begins
entry.content: • Tracking begins — Change tracking starts here: 19 models and 4,747 citations on record. From the next refresh this entry lists what moved.
